changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleThen') BEGIN create table [security].[RuleThen] ( [Id] bigint not null, [Position] int not null, [Operator] int not null, [FieldTypeId] int sparse, [Value] nvarchar(500) sparse, SecurityId int sparse, constraint [PK_Security_RuleThen] primary key clustered ( Id, [Position] asc ) ) END
